_meta.doc: Curation layer for the search field registry pipeline — SEARCH_FILTER_COMPLETENESS_PLAN_2026-07-30 §11.1 (P1). Humans own source mappings, derived-field declarations, option allowlists, and exclusions, each with a REQUIRED reason. Humans structurally CANNOT own vocabulary membership: nothing in this file can add a metadata value, only explain a divergence. Consumed by scripts/generate-search-registry.mjs and scripts/check-search-registry-generated.mjs.
_meta.keying: sources/optionAllowlist are keyed by lib/search/field-registry.ts field key. Concepts are snapshot ids: a StandardFields name ('PropertySubType'), 'cf:<Field Name>' for a parentless custom field, or 'group:<Group Label>' for a parentless boolean group.
_meta.rule: A `derived` source declares a field computed by us with no MLS vocabulary source — it requires a reason. A `viaValue` names the parent-enum value a boolean filter targets; the gate verifies it exists in the metadata.

sqft.reason: MV `sqft` is living area; LivingArea is the searchable+IDX Spark concept (BuildingAreaTotal is the non-IDX total-structure figure).

beds.reason: MV column is `beds`; Spark's standard name is BedsTotal.

baths.reason: MV column is `baths`; Spark's standard name is BathsTotal.

hoaMonthly.reason: MV `hoa_monthly` is AssociationFee frequency-normalized to a monthly figure at ingest (Spark publishes the fee plus AssociationFeeFrequency).

taxAnnual.reason: MV `tax_annual_amount` sources the RESO TaxAnnualAmount concept, which this MLS publishes as TaxAmount (CF 'Tax Annual Amount' is StandardizedAs TaxAmount).

monthlyPayment.reason: Estimated PITI computed by us from list price, prevailing rate, taxes and HOA — no MLS field exists.

dom.reason: MV `dom` carries cumulative days on market, the buyer-honest figure across relists.

aduSqft.reason: Custom field 'ADU SqFt' (General Property Information), no standard parent.

irrigationAcres.reason: MV `irrigation_acres` sources the CF 'Irrigation Water Rights Acres', StandardizedAs IrrigationWaterRightsAcres.

prevListPrice.reason: MV column is `prev_list_price`; Spark's standard name is PreviousListPrice.

hasWaterfront.reason: Spark spells the standard field WaterFrontYN (capital F), so mechanical name identity misses it.

hasView.reason: Presence-of-any-value over the View enum (MV `view_types` non-empty).

hasGolfCourse.reason: Boolean filter targeting the View enum's 'Golf Course' value (DAL expression also matches golf-course lot/HOA signals).

basement.reason: Presence-of-any-value over the Basement enum — Spark has no BasementYN standard field at our feed level; MV `basement_yn` is derived from Basement values at ingest.

hasVirtualTour.reason: Presence of the unbranded virtual-tour URL; MV `has_virtual_tour` is its non-null flag.

hasOpenHouse.reason: Computed from the Spark open-house resource joined at sync time — not a listing metadata field.

priceReduced.reason: Computed from our own price-history capture (prev_list_price > list_price) — not a listing metadata field.

ownerWillCarry.reason: Boolean filter targeting the ListingTerms value 'Owner Will Carry'.

strAllowed.reason: Boolean filter targeting the CommunityFeatures value 'Short Term Rentals Allowed'.

gatedCommunity.reason: Boolean filter targeting the AssociationAmenities value 'Gated' (DAL expression also matches ParkingFeatures 'Gated').

guestHouse.reason: Boolean filter targeting the OtherStructures value 'Guest House'.

shop.reason: Boolean filter targeting the OtherStructures value 'Workshop' (DAL expression also matches 'Workshop in Garage' parking).

rvParking.reason: Boolean filter targeting the ParkingFeatures value 'RV Access/Parking' (DAL expression also matches RV hookup/storage signals).

rvGarage.reason: Boolean filter targeting the ParkingFeatures value 'RV Garage'.

evCharging.reason: Boolean filter targeting the ParkingFeatures value 'Electric Vehicle Charging Station(s)'.

heatedGarage.reason: Boolean filter targeting the ParkingFeatures value 'Heated Garage'.

singleLevel.reason: Boolean filter targeting the Levels value 'One'.

primaryOnMain.reason: Boolean filter targeting the InteriorFeatures value 'Primary Downstairs'.

inLawFloorplan.reason: Boolean filter targeting the InteriorFeatures value 'In-Law Floorplan'.

fencedYard.reason: Boolean filter targeting the LotFeatures value 'Fenced'.

onGolfCourse.reason: Boolean filter targeting the LotFeatures value 'On Golf Course'.

adjoinsPublicLand.reason: Boolean filter targeting the LotFeatures value 'Adjoins Public Lands' (DAL expression also matches BLM adjacency phrasing).

onWell.reason: Boolean filter targeting the WaterSource value 'Well'.

publicWater.reason: Boolean filter targeting the WaterSource value 'Public'.

onSeptic.reason: Boolean filter targeting the Sewer value 'Septic Tank'.

publicSewer.reason: Boolean filter targeting the Sewer value 'Public Sewer'.

adu.reason: Custom field 'Accessory Dwelling Unit YN' (General Property Information), no standard parent.

aduPermitted.reason: Custom field 'ADU Permitted YN' (General Property Information), no standard parent.

strPermit.reason: Custom field 'Short Term Rental Permit YN' (General Property Information), no standard parent.

ccrs.reason: Custom field "CCR's YN" (General Property Information), no standard parent.

hasFloorPlan.reason: Presence of a floor-plan media asset in our media pipeline — not a listing metadata field.

hasVideo.reason: Presence of a video media asset in our media pipeline — not a listing metadata field.

appliances.reason: Spark's standard name for the appliances enum is KitchenAppliances.

heatingTypes.reason: Registry key is pluralized for the URL surface; the Spark enum is Heating.

coolingTypes.reason: Registry key is pluralized for the URL surface; the Spark enum is Cooling.

patioPorch.reason: Registry key is shortened; the Spark enum is PatioAndPorchFeatures.

viewTypes.reason: Registry key is pluralized; the Spark enum is View.

fireplaceTypes.reason: Registry key names the buyer concept; the Spark enum is FireplaceFeatures.

basementTypes.reason: Registry key is pluralized; the Spark enum is Basement.

structureTypes.reason: Registry key is pluralized; the Spark enum is StructureType.

hoaAmenities.reason: Registry key uses the buyer word HOA; the Spark enum is AssociationAmenities.

waterfrontTypes.reason: Registry key is the buyer concept; the Spark enum is WaterfrontFeatures.

sewerTypes.reason: Registry key is pluralized; the Spark enum is Sewer.

roadSurface.reason: Registry key drops the Type suffix; the Spark enum is RoadSurfaceType.

roofTypes.reason: Registry key is pluralized; the Spark enum is Roof.

foundationTypes.reason: Registry key names the buyer concept; the Spark enum is FoundationDetails.

architecturalStyles.reason: Registry key is pluralized; the Spark enum is ArchitecturalStyle (whose own metadata Label is the anomalous 'A-Frame' — see snapshot anomalies).

levelsOptions.reason: Registry key is suffixed to avoid colliding with the singleLevel boolean; the Spark enum is Levels.

specialConditions.reason: Registry key is shortened; the Spark enum is SpecialListingConditions.

roadFrontage.reason: Registry key drops the Type suffix; the Spark enum is RoadFrontageType.

county.reason: Registry key is the buyer word; the Spark standard name is CountyOrParish.

floodZone.reason: The MLS publishes flood zone as the parentless boolean group 'Flood'; values are the member labels.

middleSchool.reason: Registry key is the buyer word; the Spark standard name is MiddleOrJuniorSchool.

zoning.reason: Plan §6: details Zoning is masked on 9,485 of 9,627 on-market rows; ZoningDescription is the canonical source and a strict superset — the pipeline pins to it explicitly.

irrigationDistrict.reason: Custom field 'Irrigation District' (General Property Information), no standard parent.

keywords.reason: Free-text search over the public remarks body.

walkScore.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: no Walk Score field exists at our Spark feed access level; MV column 100% null — a guaranteed-zero filter. Re-add only if the feed changes AND observed coverage is nonzero.

storiesTotal.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: Spark masks StoriesTotal at our feed access level ('********' on every row); MV column 100% null. Buyer intent survives via levelsOptions (Levels).

fireplacesTotal.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: Spark masks FireplacesTotal at our feed access level; MV column 100% null. Buyer intent survives via hasFireplace (FireplaceYN) and fireplaceTypes.

carportSpaces.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: Spark masks CarportSpaces at our feed access level; MV column 100% null. Buyer intent survives via parkingFeatures carport options.

parkingTotal.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: no ParkingTotal field at our Spark feed access level; MV column 100% null.

spa.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: SpaYN absent/masked at our feed level; MV 100% null. Buyer intent survives via exteriorFeatures/interiorFeatures 'Spa/Hot Tub' (605 live rows), which carry the moved voice phrases.

carport.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: CarportYN absent/masked at our feed level; MV 100% null. Buyer intent survives via parkingFeatures 'Attached Carport'/'Detached Carport' (188 live rows).

homeWarranty.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: HomeWarrantyYN absent/masked at our feed level; MV 100% null — a guaranteed-zero filter.

directionFaces.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: DirectionFaces masked ('********') on 9,407 of 9,648 MV rows — the feed does not license it; all 8 compass options returned zero, always.

schoolDistrict.reason: Adversarial accuracy audit: every non-null school_district MV value was the mask marker '********' — the feed does not license SchoolDistrict. The elementary/middle/high school NAME filters remain (those columns carry real values).

laundryFeatures.reason: laundry_features carried zero values across all 9,663 on-market listing_search_mv rows — the field could never match a listing and the sheet always hid it.
